stem: (Select TWO.) Quarry Bank's auditors ask how failed policy checks are handled in HCP Terraform. Which two statements are correct?

choices.text: A failed OPA mandatory policy can be overridden by a user with Manage Policy Overrides
A failed Sentinel advisory policy pauses the run until a permitted user overrides it
A failed Sentinel hard mandatory policy can be overridden only if its policy set allows overrides
A failed Sentinel soft mandatory policy ends the run with no way to continue it
OPA offers the same three enforcement levels as Sentinel: advisory, soft mandatory and hard mandatory

rationale: OPA has two enforcement levels, advisory and mandatory, and a failed mandatory policy can be overridden by a user with the Manage Policy Overrides permission. A Sentinel hard mandatory failure stops the run and is treated as not overridable by default; only a policy set configured to allow overrides changes that, and the setting takes precedence over the policy's own level. A Sentinel advisory failure never interrupts the run, so there is nothing to override. A soft mandatory failure stops the run, but it can be continued when team members are allowed to override failures. OPA does not mirror Sentinel's three levels, since it has only advisory and mandatory.
